visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair wearing a white backless dress is seated at a black upright piano in a transit station. She begins to play with focused movements of her hands on the keys. In the background, a green "Ticketing Service Kiosks" sign is visible above a colorful floral mural. (2) The camera moves to a medium shot, revealing more of the station's interior. A staff member in a blue shirt walks past, and commuters are seen in the distance. The woman continues playing while looking up occasionally, expressing emotional depth through her facial expressions and steady posture. (3) The scene shifts to a group of young female students dressed in blue school uniforms. They are holding traditional wooden instruments called Angklung. They watch the woman with smiles and curiosity as she approaches them after finishing her piano performance to strike up a conversation. (4) The woman is now interacting closely with the students, holding one of the Angklung instruments herself. She mimics the shaking motion to produce sound, laughing and smiling brightly. The students participate, showing her how to play, creating a lively and joyful atmosphere in the public space. (5) A graphic overlay appears at the end of the video, showing a screenshot of a YouTube channel profile. The profile features a photo of the same woman, identified as "我是江老師," along with music-related icons and subscriber counts, concluding the visual sequence with a promotional call to action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The recording starts with a clear, melodic piano sequence played in a steady, moderate tempo. A female voice with a smooth, resonant timbre begins singing lyrics in Mandarin with moderate pitch variability and high articulation clarity. The acoustic environment has a noticeable room reverb characteristic of a large indoor hall. (2) As the singing continues, the vocal intensity increases, showing higher emotional arousal and a wider pitch range. The piano accompaniment becomes more complex with fuller chords. There is no significant background noise interference, indicating a high signal-to-noise ratio and clean audio capture despite being in a public area. (3) The music stops and is immediately followed by the sound of enthusiastic applause and vocal cheering from a nearby crowd. The primary female voice transitions into a casual, high-arousal speaking tone, greeting others in a mixture of English and Mandarin with a friendly and excited inflection. (4) A new acoustic layer enters as multiple wooden percussive sounds are heard, characterized by rapid, rattling transients. These are the sounds of Angklung instruments being shaken. The female speaker reacts with high-pitched exclamations of "Ah! Cool!" while the rhythmic, resonant wooden clatter continues in the background. (5) The audio concludes with a brief, upbeat musical jingle and a final vocal sign-off from the main character, maintaining a high level of energy and professional clarity throughout the transition.
